messages:
nina (Docs): heads up, PR for SDK snippet cleanup + new quickstart on rotating API keys. preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/815. tagging @rene @tara for sensitive content review.

rene (Security): quick note: please avoid showing service principal IDs in examples. i see `service_principal: sp-7b2`. replace with `service_principal: ${SERVICE_PRINCIPAL}`. also request a DLP check.

nina (Docs): got it, swapping placeholders and requesting DLP. also there is a section that suggests storing rotated keys in `~/secrets/keys.txt` as a local example. should we remove?

rene (Security): remove that suggestion. instead reference KMS/secret manager examples. we can't encourage plaintext file storage.

ci-bot: dlp-scan started for PR 815 -> completed: no high-risk issues, 2 low-risk TODO comment strings flagged.

mike (Eng): from Product/Platform: FYI the SDK snippet uses an older client signature `new RedwoodClient({apiKey})`. can you update to the newer `RedwoodClient.fromEnv()` pattern? otherwise we'll need a follow-up patch.

nina (Docs): updated SDK snippets to use `RedwoodClient.fromEnv()` and swapped file-store example to KMS reference + example code. pushed changes.

ci-bot: ci/docs-preview: success -> https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-815/quickstart

rene (Security): reviewing again. LGTM. one request: add a single-line redaction footer in the page metadata: `redaction: required` so docs automation shows it in the redaction dashboard.

tara (Legal): approved on my side. flagged one sentence about "we don't retain your keys" as technically sensitive; please reword to "avoid storing keys in logs or source control."

nina (Docs): revised wording and added `redaction: required` to frontmatter. pushed.

mike (Eng): ok to merge after Legal+Security signoff and CI green. we'll gate publish as requested.

ci-bot: merge complete -> Merge pull request #815 from docs/sdk-rotate-quickstart, commit a1b2c3

nina (Docs): merged. creating a small release note and linking approved preview + legal wording to #release-notes for the upcoming weekly release. thanks all.
